title: Scenario C — ambiguous requirement: safer shared links
requirement: Make shared links safer. Old campaign links should stop working, and we need useful analytics.

suggested_answers.answer: Expiry is optional and explicitly set per link using a UTC timestamp (expires_at) at creation; there is no automatic age-based expiry.
Links without expiry remain valid forever, including all existing links (NULL expires_at).
An expired link must respond with HTTP 404 and must not increment the click count; aggregate successful-click counts remain readable via stats.
Only aggregate successful redirect counts per link plus expiry status in stats. Do not collect visitor identity, IP, user agent, or detailed tracking.

revision_text: Make shared links safer. Old campaign links should stop working, and we need useful analytics. REVISION: an expired link must respond with HTTP 410 Gone (not 404) and must not increment the click count.
